title: Woo Ching Ying

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 245
Date 11/4/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

11th April 1916.

Sir,
Reports that the rebels intend to start a rising
still continue and extraordinary precautions are being
taken in Chinese territory.
A meeting of high rebel officers was held in the
western part of Frenchtown yesterday for the purpose
of discussing ways and means to deal with the local
situation. It was announced that the rebels had
arranged with the City Police and several units of
the Arsenal garrison to support them. It was also
stated that the rebels had given up hope of converting
General Yang to their cause.
A thousand men left the Arsenal by boat for Kiukiang
yesterday morning.
It is reported that thirty soldiers who are said
to have been concerned in the alleged mutiny at Woo
Ching Ying 滬軍營 camp were shot at the Arsenal
yesterday.

Your obedient servant,

[签名]

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

[签名]
11/4

Entered on M.S. Apl. 11.
page_data.zh:
刑事调查处
情报官登记
第 245 号
日期 1916 年 4 月 11 日

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1916 年 4 月 11 日。

先生：

关于叛军意图发动起义的报告仍在继续，华界方面正在采取特别防范措施。

昨日，法租界西部举行了一次叛军高级军官会议，旨在讨论应对当地局势的方法与手段。会上宣布，叛军已与华界巡警及兵工厂驻军的数个部队达成安排，以获得他们的支持。另有说法称，叛军已放弃争取杨将军加入其阵营的希望。

昨晨，一千人乘船离开兵工厂前往九江。

据报，三十名据称卷入沪军营所谓兵变的士兵，昨日在兵工厂被枪决。

您顺从的仆人，

[签名]

首席侦探督察长。

警务处总监。

[签名]
1916 年 4 月 11 日

于 4 月 11 日录入工部局档案。
